_comment: Static map from exact Google Form checklist option text to category slug. Checklist answers are already category-shaped, so they are resolved by direct lookup and NEVER sent to the LLM classifier or the regex fallback - that path is reserved for free text. Hand-maintained: if an option is added to the form, add it here or ingestion will fail loudly rather than silently guess.

v0.note: Original checklist. Offered unqualified 'Iceberg lettuce' and 'Romaine lettuce' with no whole-head vs prepackaged distinction.

v1.note: Lettuce split into (head) and (prepackaged) variants, and mesclun/spring mix added.

form_versions.cutoff_evidence: Derived from the data, not assumed: the last response selecting an unqualified lettuce option is 2026-07-13 12:50:56 and the first selecting a qualified one is 2026-07-13 16:21:12. Zero overlap, so the form changed inside that 3.5-hour window; 14:00 sits in the gap.
